items.defectStatement: Mode 3 Create and Update call recordLegacyDuration when unified Storage fails, attributing unified-storage latency and errors to legacy storage.
obligations: Record failed unified Create and Update operations in the storage duration metric with the error flag set.
Preserve timing, labels, error logging, and returned results.
Do not record legacy operations that were never attempted.
items.notes: The defect requires simple recorder substitutions at both failure sites, but this item has no usable anchor. Failed operations should still be measured.

items.defectStatement: The asynchronous legacy DeleteCollection records its duration through recordStorageDuration, attributing legacy latency and failures to unified storage.
obligations: Record the legacy DeleteCollection observation in the legacy duration metric.
Preserve its error flag, labels, and legacy start time.
items.notes: A recorder substitution fixes the defect, but this item has no usable anchor.

items.defectStatement: The asynchronous legacy Create, Update, Delete, and DeleteCollection calls discard their error details after recording a metric flag. Legacy replication failures therefore lose the diagnostic logging present before this change.
obligations: Log non-nil legacy write errors for all four operations using a contextual logger.
Include the actual error and identify the failed legacy operation.
Preserve duration observations and asynchronous execution.
Keep legacy failures from replacing the unified-storage result returned to callers.
items.notes: The anchor covers only Create. Adding logging there is a partial fix; the finding explicitly includes the other three goroutines, which the diff shows.

items.defectStatement: Delete's successful unified-storage observation passes the object name as the kind label, producing per-object metric series and inconsistent labels between success and failure.
obligations: Use options.Kind for the successful Delete observation's kind label.
Preserve the storage recorder, success flag, mode, method, and start time.
items.notes: The complete fix fits in the cited line.

items.defectStatement: Mode 3 Delete returns immediately when unified storage reports NotFound, skipping legacy deletion. Objects present only in legacy storage are consequently left behind.
obligations: Attempt legacy deletion when unified deletion succeeds or reports Kubernetes NotFound.
Continue returning early for other unified-storage errors.
Preserve the unified-storage result, deletion flag, and error returned to callers.
Record the unified operation once without treating NotFound as a successful deletion.
items.notes: Restoring apierrors.IsNotFound requires its removed import outside the anchor. Allowing NotFound to fall through also requires adjusting the unconditional success observation at line 106 to avoid incorrect or duplicate metrics.

items.defectStatement: Legacy.Update receives the original objInfo, causing it to recompute the update against legacy's potentially stale object. It can therefore store a different result or fail after unified storage has successfully committed the update.
obligations: Supply the object returned by successful Storage.Update to the legacy update instead of recomputing it.
Preserve the remaining update arguments and the error variable consumed by duration recording.
items.notes: The diff shows the prior updateWrapper usage and field names; the window shows res. The existing wrapper returns the supplied object and delegates preconditions upstream.
